description: Angular component for editing links in the Thingsboard UI, including form handling, drag-and-drop reordering, and updating user settings.

classes.name: EditLinksDialogComponent
classes.description: Angular dialog component for editing documentation or quick links, with form controls, drag-and-drop, and update logic.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the form with existing links.

methods.name: linksFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of links.

methods.name: trackByLink
methods.description: Tracks links by control reference for optimization.

methods.name: addLink
methods.description: Prepares to add a new link.

methods.name: linkAdded
methods.description: Adds a new link to the form and updates.

methods.name: deleteLink
methods.description: Removes a link from the form and updates.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Saves the current links via user settings service.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the dialog, returning whether updates occurred.
